before.requirement: The frozen key-qualified object-member type diagnostic was not supported; a type mismatch reported the expected and actual types without the member key.
before.reason: The object unpacker did not pass the member key to typed validation, and the type error text had no key qualifier.

after.requirement: For a keyed object member of the wrong expected type, an error-reporting unpack can include that member key in the type diagnostic.
after.reason: The object unpacker passes the key to typed validation, which includes it in the diagnostic. The old harness calls json_unpack, whose wrapper supplies a null error pointer; its object formats also use only the untyped 'o' extraction.

claims.reason: The same old harness has no route to the new key-qualified diagnostic. That specific diagnostic was not supported before the change.
